public_health_question.v: What was the prevalence of antimicrobial resistance, especially ceftriaxone resistance, among N. gonorrhoeae isolates in China in 2022, and how did it vary by province and change since 2017?

ev.q: This report describes gonococcal resistance surveillance data from China for 2022, the most recent year for which data are available.
Reported cases and rates of gonorrhea and proportion of isolates available for antimicrobial susceptibility tests, by province
continuously monitors gonococcal antimicrobial resistance. In 2022, 13 China-GRSP sentinel sites collected 2,804 gonococcal isolates
These data highlight a substantial increase in ceftriaxone resistance from 2017 to 2022.
The China Gonococcal Resistance Surveillance Program (China-GRSP), established in 1987 and covering 19 of 34 provincial-level administrative units

equity.level_reason: No results by any social-position dimension; sociodemographic factors are raised only as a limitation and a recommendation for future research.

level_alternative.reason: The limitation names sociodemographic factors only generically, with no specific social-position dimension, so it may not count as raising equity.

ev.q: this analysis focused on antimicrobial resistance rates and did not address broader sociodemographic factors influencing gonorrhea transmission.

equity.equity_measurement: Comparisons are geographic (province, region), which is not an SPD; no patient sociodemographic data are reported.

notes: Agar dilution MIC testing with EUCAST/WHO breakpoints defines resistance (a lab measurement plus quantization), so no procedures are recorded. The 2017 comparison value (2.9%) is presumably from earlier China-GRSP data, but its source is not stated. The UK, US and Canada prevalences are cited from external reports and serve as context only.
view_issues: Table 2 percentages do not always match the counts over isolates tested: Guangxi ceftriaxone is 45/719 (6.3%, not 7.6%), and Jiangsu cefixime is 55/248 (22.2%, not 28.2%). The text says 'Shaanxi' where the table says 'Shanxi'.
